name: Whole Plant Render
instruction: show one complete mature specimen with roots or root flare, all stems, foliage, and reproductive structures

name: Botanical Portrait
instruction: emphasize defining branching, foliage, flowers, fruit, or surface materials

name: Orthographic Front
instruction: exact front orthographic view with no perspective distortion

name: Orthographic Side
instruction: exact side orthographic view with no perspective distortion

name: Orthographic Top
instruction: exact top-down view showing spread pattern and canopy density

name: Root System
instruction: show complete roots, rhizomes, runners, holdfasts, or anchor structures

name: Stem and Branch Study
instruction: show basal stems, branch hierarchy, joints, growth points, and load distribution

name: Bark and Surface Study
instruction: show young, mature, damaged, repaired, waxy, mineral, synthetic, or field surfaces

name: Leaf or Collector Study
instruction: show front, back, edge, juvenile, mature, seasonal, and damaged states

name: Reproductive Structure
instruction: show closed, opening, mature, pollinated, and spent stages

name: Fruit or Storage Body
instruction: show external form, internal cross-section, ripening, and dispersal function

name: Seed or Propagule Study
instruction: show seeds, spores, pods, packets, dispersal, germination, and establishment

name: Internal Cross Section
instruction: show protection, transport, support, storage, energy capture, and reproductive tissues

name: Growth Stages
instruction: show propagule, juvenile, spreading, mature, reproductive, and senescent stages

name: Seasonal Variants
instruction: show growth, bloom, fruiting, stress, dormancy, and recovery states

name: Native Habitat
instruction: show a natural population with realistic spacing, age diversity, and climate interaction

name: Biome Composition
instruction: show this archetype integrated with compatible flora at consistent scale

name: Discovery Scan
instruction: centered scientific scan source with restrained contour illumination

name: UI Icon
instruction: strong isolated silhouette readable at 64 pixels

name: Scale Comparison
instruction: side view beside a simple adult human silhouette and one-meter bar, no text

name: Master Botanical Plate
instruction: whole plant, views, roots, stems, surface, leaves, reproduction, growth, seasonal states, materials, and habitat vignette

name: PSD Extraction Board
instruction: isolated full plant, root system, main stems, foliage clusters, reproductive parts, silhouette, and material swatches
